parole.significato: sensor (device that detects certain external stimuli)
parole.testo: andma (“to give”) + -r. Calque of German Geber (“encoder”) and Russian датчик (datčik, “transducer, gauge, sensor”).

parole.significato: form master, homeroom teacher, class teacher (teacher responsible for a particular form/class)
parole.testo: From klass + juhataja. Calque of German Klassenleiter or Russian кла́ссный руководи́тель (klássnyj rukovodítelʹ)
From German Kondensator or Russian конденса́тор (kondensátor).

From võrra + -nd, from the root of võrd. Calque of German Gleichung or Russian уравне́ние (uravnénije), both of which ultimately calque Latin aequatio. For the meaning of the root, compare võrdne (“equal”), võrdus (“equality”).
